statement: Reconstruct only the anonymous English Coursera homepage captured twice in the supplied WACZ, with local visual assets and explicit manual promotional switching. Every uncaptured destination stays unavailable and every runtime request remains same-origin.

actor_scope.notes: Anonymous public homepage visitor. The supplied WACZ contains no authenticated or secondary route capture.

simulations: sim.manual-promo: the captured three promotional items are switched only through deterministic local controls and never through autoplay.
sim.archive-boundary: uncaptured destination controls announce the homepage-only boundary without navigation or remote effects.
out_of_scope: Every route other than the homepage, including search results, course detail, authentication, account, enrollment, checkout, and learning.
Analytics, advertising, consent transmission, identity providers, remote fonts, third-party widgets, and any non-loopback runtime request.
Persistent accounts, password recovery, transactional email, payments, orders, database state, public deployment, and publication.

release_authority.note: Diagnostics are diagnostic-only. This work is left uncommitted for the user's manual local review.
